item.description: La Administración Trump concederá un préstamo de casi 100 millones de dólares a Africell, la única empresa de telecomunicaciones africana de propiedad estadounidense, en un intento por frenar la expansión de la china Huawei en el continente, según un comunicado de prensa y una persona familiarizada con el asunto.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Alper
item.content:encoded: La Administración Trump concederá un préstamo de casi 100 millones de dólares a Africell, la única empresa de telecomunicaciones africana de propiedad estadounidense, en un intento por frenar la expansión de la china Huawei en el continente, según un comunicado de prensa y una persona familiarizada con el asunto. El préstamo del Banco de Exportación e Importación "permitirá a Africell invertir en la tecnología más avanzada para redes móviles de proveedores estadounidenses y aliados", según indicó el comunicado, publicado el viernes y del que informó en primicia Reuters. "Nos complace colaborar con el EXIM para introducir una infraestructura de comunicaciones más fiable y segura en los mercados en los que operamos", afirmó Ziad Dalloul, presidente ejecutivo de Africell Holding Limited. Huawei no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. La embajada china en Washington señaló que la inversión china en África ha impulsado el crecimiento en la región y ha sido bien recibida por los residentes. Asimismo, instó a Estados Unidos a hacer más por apoyar el desarrollo de otros países y a no "llevar a cabo su agenda africana con el objetivo de socavar la cooperación entre China y África". El préstamo forma parte de la campaña de Washington para impulsar el uso de equipos de telecomunicaciones que no sean de Huawei en el extranjero. El Gobierno del presidente Donald Trump lanzó la iniciativa "red limpia" en su primer mandato para eliminar la tecnología de telecomunicaciones, las aplicaciones y los operadores chinos de las infraestructuras de Estados Unidos y sus aliados, y ha proseguido con esfuerzos similares durante su segundo mandato. Estados Unidos ha impuesto duras sanciones a Huawei por acusaciones de que la empresa podría espiar a los usuarios, algo que Huawei niega. Según Counterpoint Research, Huawei cuenta con una cuota de mercado cercana al 52% en la infraestructura 5G en África.

item.title: Ireland's Dunbar reels in leading climber Buitrago for Stage 19 Vuelta victory
item.description: Irishman Eddie Dunbar overtook leading climber Santiago Buitrago with 500m remaining in Stage 19 of the Vuelta a Espana to secure an impressive victory on Friday while Spanish rider Enric Mas successfully defended his lead atop the general classification.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Irishman Eddie Dunbar overtook leading climber Santiago Buitrago with 500m remaining in Stage 19 of the Vuelta a Espana to secure an impressive victory on Friday while Spanish rider Enric Mas successfully defended his lead atop the general classification. Dunbar's Pinarello Q36.5 teammate Thomas Gloag came third on the hilly 210.8km route from Velez-Malaga to Estepona. Early in the day, a series of breakaway groups struggled to escape the peloton. At the first summit, Dunbar was among a group of 16 riders who held a 28-second advantage over the peloton. The gap widened significantly during the middle of the route, reaching 07:29 before the final climb up Penas Blancas. Buitrago (Bahrain Victorious), wearing the polkadot jersey, began to pull away from the group 12km from the finish line with Dunbar and Gloag for company. It looked as if the Colombian would drive clear when he attacked with 2km remaining, but Dunbar remained tenacious to chase him up the hill. By the time they were level, Dunbar had the energy to power past Buitrago. "I really didn't expect this today, I even said on the radio after about 50-60km, that I wasn't feeling good," said Dunbar. "This year I had three months out after a bad accident, without riding a bike. I really didn't think I'd be here at all. Let alone competing to win anything." It is a second stage win at the Vuelta for 30-year-old Dunbar, his previous victory coming in 2024. In the general classification, primary challengers Richard Carapaz (EF Education-EasyPost) and Primoz Roglic (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) made individual breakaway attempts throughout the day. The first came after 107km, but neither was able to detach from [USN:L1N44V0NV TEXT:"race leader Mas"] (Movistar). On the final climb, Carapaz and Roglic made final efforts to push clear, but Mas kept Roglic comfortably close to him. Roglic and Mas crossed the finish line alongside each other, 5:11 behind Dunbar. Mas goes into the penultimate stage on Saturday with a strong 1:37 lead over Roglic. Stage 20 is a 186.8km mountainous route from La Calahorra to Collado del Alguacil.

item.title: Glencore, Mercuria among firms pursuing Venezuela aluminium smelter deal, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: London-listed miner Glencore and Swiss-based commodities trader Mercuria Energy are among firms interested in a deal for Venezuela's largest aluminium smelter, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: London-listed miner Glencore (GLEN.L) and Swiss-based commodities trader Mercuria Energy are among firms interested in a deal for Venezuela's largest aluminium smelter, Bloomberg News reported on Friday. The two companies are in separate discussions with the Venezuelan government about a deal for the Venalum smelter that could include operating the facility and gaining access to the aluminium it produces, according to people familiar with the matter. Here are some more details: Mercuria is working with private mining investment firm Heeney Capital on the potential deal, though no final agreement has been reached, the report said. Venalum, also referred to as CVG Venezolana del Aluminio, is a state-owned Venezuelan aluminium producer that operates in Puerto Ordaz in Bolivar state, with capacity to roughly produce 430,000 metric tons of primary aluminium per year. Glencore declined to comment on the report, while Mercuria Energy and Venalum did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Glencore had ties to Venezuela's aluminium industry more than two decades ago and later extended financing to the country's aluminium producers, according to the report. [USN:L6N40T0Q8 TEXT:"Earlier"] this year, Glencore bought a 45% interest in an aluminium recycling and remelting plant near Charleston, South Carolina, expanding its footprint in the U.S. aluminium market. Aluminium prices had climbed to a three-week high earlier this [USN:L1N44V0AG TEXT:"month"], driven by supply tightness as a result of the Middle East tensions.

item.title: Après son triomphe électoral, l'AfD en quête d'alliés pour former un gouvernement régional
item.description: Après son triomphe aux élections régionales en Saxe-Anhalt, le parti d'extrême droite allemand AfD doit soit attirer des transfuges d'autres formations pour espérer former un gouvernement, soit parvenir à un accord avec le parti d'extrême gauche BSW, qui pose des conditions en échange de son soutien.
item.dc:creator: James Mackenzie
item.content:encoded: Après son [USN:L8N44Y0DJ TEXT:"triomphe"] aux élections régionales en Saxe-Anhalt, le parti d'extrême droite allemand AfD doit soit attirer des transfuges d'autres formations pour espérer former un gouvernement, soit parvenir à un accord avec le parti d'extrême gauche BSW, qui pose des conditions en échange de son soutien. Ulrich Siegmund, le chef de l’AfD qui devrait devenir ministre-président du Land, a déclaré que des discussions étaient en cours tant avec le BSW qu’avec des membres d’autres partis "afin de voir s’il existe un terrain d’entente susceptible de permettre d’obtenir une majorité stable". Il a ajouté qu’il souhaitait former une telle majorité au sein du parlement régional "dès que possible". Il n’y a rien d’inhabituel dans la politique allemande à ce que les négociations de coalition durent des semaines, voire des mois, avant qu’un gouvernement puisse être formé. Ces discussions mettent en évidence les réalités politiques auxquelles est désormais confronté Ulrich Siegmund, qui a répété à plusieurs reprises pendant la campagne qu’il souhaitait obtenir la majorité absolue pour pouvoir gouverner seul, mais qui a échoué de peu, remportant 39 sièges sur les 83 que compte le Parlement. Même s’il parvient à conclure un accord avec un autre parti lui permettant de devenir ministre-président, sa majorité risque d’être très étroite, ce qui rendra la tâche plus compliquée que ne le laisserait supposer son score record aux élections. L'AFD BOYCOTTÉE PAR LES PARTIS TRADITIONNELS ALLEMANDS L’Alternative pour l’Allemagne (AfD) est déjà le parti le plus populaire du pays au niveau national et cherche à s’implanter pour [USN:L6N4500I1 TEXT:"faire avancer son programme"], qui prévoit notamment de fortes restrictions en matière d’immigration, le rétablissement des relations avec la Russie, la réduction du soutien à l’Ukraine et la sortie de l’euro. Cependant, tous les autres partis représentés au Parlement régional de Saxe-Anhalt, tout comme au niveau national, ont refusé de s’allier à ce parti d’extrême droite, à l’exception du BSW, un petit parti d’extrême gauche qui, à l’instar de l’AfD, souhaite restreindre l’immigration et rétablir les relations avec la Russie. Le BSW, qui a remporté cinq sièges au Parlement régional, s’est dit intéressé par une collaboration avec l’AfD, que la branche de Saxe-Anhalt de l’Office fédéral de protection de la Constitution classe parmi les mouvements d’extrême droite extrémistes. Mais jusqu’à présent, le BSW a indiqué ne pas vouloir former de coalition officielle et souhaiter la nomination d’un ministre-président indépendant, une condition que Siegmund rejette. "Un peu moins de 44% des électeurs de Saxe-Anhalt ont voté pour l’Alternative pour l’Allemagne", a déclaré Ulrich Siegmund aux journalistes jeudi à Magdebourg, la capitale du Land. "Naturellement, notre objectif devrait être de pouvoir désigner le ministre-président." Si aucun accord n'est trouvé avec le BSW, l’alternative la plus probable serait de convaincre des députés de la CDU (Union chrétienne-démocrate), le parti conservateur du chancelier Friedrich Merz - ils sont 15 au Parlement régional - d'apporter leur soutien à l’AfD. Au sein de la CDU, les avis sont partagés quant à la stratégie dite de "pare-feu" mise en place par les grands partis allemands pour isoler l’AfD, et il pourrait être possible d’inciter certains à changer de camp. Mais jusqu’à présent, aucun transfuge confirmé n’a été identifié. Si aucun accord ne peut être trouvé, Ulrich Siegmund a même évoqué la possibilité d’organiser de nouvelles élections, affirmant que c’était "une option que nous n’écartons pas, en principe". "Cela résulterait d’une situation où personne d’autre ne serait prêt à assumer la responsabilité", a-t-il déclaré.

item.title: Funcionários da Micron em Taiwan receberão bônus equivalentes a até 68 meses de salário
item.description: A Micron Technology informou nesta sexta-feira que seus funcionários em Taiwan receberão bônus equivalentes a 35 a 68 meses de salário referentes ao ano fiscal de 2026, enquanto a fabricante de chips dos Estados Unidos enfrenta uma disputa trabalhista em andamento com sindicatos.
item.dc:creator: Wen-Yee Lee
item.content:encoded: A Micron Technology (MU.O) informou nesta sexta-feira que seus funcionários em Taiwan receberão bônus equivalentes a 35 a 68 meses de salário referentes ao ano fiscal de 2026, enquanto a fabricante de chips dos Estados Unidos enfrenta uma disputa trabalhista em andamento com sindicatos. A Micron afirmou que os pagamentos são os maiores de sua história e que mais de 60 mil funcionários em todo o mundo receberão bônus pelo exercício fiscal de 2026, "após um ano extraordinário para a empresa". O anúncio ocorre após sindicatos que representam cerca de dois terços da força de trabalho da Micron em Taiwan sinalizarem amplo apoio dos membros a uma greve. O sindicato de Taoyuan declarou em comunicado nesta sexta-feira que ainda não chegou a um consenso com a Micron na disputa em curso e continua buscando mudanças no sistema de remuneração da companhia, defendendo que 15% do lucro operacional seja destinado a bônus dos funcionários. "Se a empresa não responder a essas demandas, o sindicato continuará avançando em direção a uma greve", afirmou a entidade. A fabricante de memórias informou que os incentivos incluem um bônus em dinheiro de 1 milhão de dólares taiwaneses (US$31.653) para funcionários de Taiwan contratados antes de 29 de agosto de 2025, referente ao ano fiscal de 2026. Para engenheiros em início de carreira, a remuneração total média será de 3,4 milhões de dólares taiwaneses, incluindo cerca de 2,9 milhões de dólares taiwaneses em dinheiro. O valor restante será composto por ações da empresa, consideradas pelo valor atribuído no momento da concessão. Além disso, todos os funcionários receberão uma concessão anual de ações, informou a Micron. SEM ACORDO COM O SINDICATO A Micron emprega cerca de 15 mil pessoas em Taiwan, um de seus mais importantes polos de produção, e afirma já ter investido mais de 1,6 trilhão de dólares taiwaneses na ilha. A empresa busca evitar uma crise semelhante à enfrentada pela rival sul-coreana Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) em maio, quando uma greve planejada de 18 dias por até 48 mil funcionários sindicalizados foi cancelada após negociações de última hora. O acordo firmado criou um fundo especial de bônus equivalente a 10,5% do lucro operacional da divisão de chips, condicionado a metas de rentabilidade. Na época, a possibilidade de uma paralisação na maior fabricante mundial de chips de memória gerou preocupações sobre o fornecimento global de semicondutores e potenciais impactos econômicos na quarta maior economia da Ásia. Os sindicatos da Micron em Taiwan já haviam argumentado anteriormente que os programas de participação nos lucros da Samsung e da SK Hynix (000660.KS) ampliaram a diferença de remuneração entre os trabalhadores da Micron e seus pares sul-coreanos. (Reportagem de Wen-Yee Lee)

item.title: 米、サイクロスポラ集団感染の終息宣言 複数州で過去最大規模に拡大
item.description: [１１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１１日 ロイター] - 米保健当局は１１日、激しい下痢や腹痛を伴う感染症のサイクロスポラ症の集団感染の終息を宣言した。汚染されたレタスが原因とされるこの集団感染は、複数州にまたがり過去最大規模に拡大していた。

米疾病対策センター（ＣＤＣ）は１１日、現時点でレタスからサイクロスポラ症に感染するリスクはないとの見解を示した。また、集団感染に関連した全ての商品は既に賞味期限を過ぎており、店頭やレストランでは提供されていないと述べた。

ＣＤＣの最新データによると、この集団感染により２１州で計１万２８８３人が発症し、５７０人が入院、２人が死亡した。

連邦および州の保健当局によると、ミシガン州は今回の集団感染で最も大きな被害を受けた州の一つで、州内では１万４０００件超の症例と、２人の死亡例が確認された。オハイオ州とミズーリ州でも、テイラー・ファームズの汚染レタスに関連する感染例が数千件確認された。

item.title: Top Weil dealmaker to depart with M&A team for rival law firm Cravath
item.description: Prominent New York dealmaker Michael Aiello is set to depart his longtime law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges alongside five other M&A partners for Cravath, Swaine & Moore, extending a recent string of senior Weil exits.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: Prominent New York dealmaker Michael Aiello is set to depart his longtime law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges alongside five other M&A partners for Cravath, Swaine & Moore, extending a recent string of senior Weil exits. Cravath said on Friday that Aiello will join the firm with Weil partners Matthew Gilroy, Eoghan Keenan, Amanda Fenster, Michelle Sargent and Megan Pendleton. Aiello was chairman of Weil’s 600-lawyer corporate department and has represented clients including Dow Chemical, Goldman Sachs and Sanofi. Gilroy co-leads Weil’s M&A practice. Aiello and his team “are extraordinarily talented M&A advisors and a unique fit within our culture,” Faiza Saeed, presiding partner at Cravath, said in a statement. A Weil spokesperson thanked the team for their contributions. “Weil has long believed that an ambitious growth strategy is in the firm's best interest and intends to accelerate execution of that strategy going forward,” the spokesperson said in a statement. New York-founded Weil has lost a series of top partners to other firms in recent weeks, including the co-head of its private equity group, Chris Machera, who joined Paul Weiss; U.S. private funds group co-head Stephanie Srulowitz, who joined Simpson Thacher; and global white-collar defense co-head Daniel Stein, who joined Freshfields this week. Weil’s longtime executive partner Barry Wolf is set to retire as partner at the firm at the end of next year and hand over the top leadership role to private equity partner Ramona Nee starting in January. Aiello was named chair of a new global strategy committee when the leadership transition was announced in March.

item.title: Chevron CEO says depleted crude oil buffers could lead to higher prices
item.description: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth said on Friday that oil buffers that limited crude price increases earlier in the Iran war have been depleted, and the conflict could lift prices further over the next few months.
item.dc:creator: Sheila Dang
item.content:encoded: Chevron (CVX.N) CEO Mike Wirth said on Friday that oil buffers that limited crude price increases earlier in the Iran war have been depleted, and the conflict could lift prices further over the next few months. Since the war began in late February, countries have released some crude stockpiles to the market, and the U.S. also lifted restrictions on oil stored on ships floating at sea from countries under sanctions. Those buffers have now been "played out," Wirth said while speaking at a University of Texas at Austin energy conference. "It's harder to envision a scenario where prices soften and quickly," he said. "I think the risks remain to the upside over the next few months." The average price of diesel in the U.S. hit [USN:L6N4521A4 TEXT:"$6 per gallon"] for the first time on Thursday, as the Iran war, combined with Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries, squeezed supply. Brent crude futures remain on track for a [USN:L1N45303L TEXT:"weekly gain"] of 8%. CHEVRON SEEING FEWER IMPACTS ON KAZAKHSTAN OPERATIONS Wirth said the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump had spoken with Ukraine about its attacks on oil infrastructure in Russia's Black Sea, and that the company since then has seen fewer impacts on its operations in the region. Chevron operates the massive Tengiz oilfield in Kazakhstan, and also holds a stake in the Caspian Pipeline Consortium, which operates an export pipeline from Tengiz to the Black Sea. Wirth added the company will fund its planned $7 billion investment to expand in Venezuela entirely with cash generated by its three existing joint ventures in the country. Last week, Chevron signed new contract terms with the Venezuelan government to expand to two new oil areas and more than double output to about 600,000 barrels per day by 2031. "We'll live entirely within the means of those ventures' ability to generate cash, not bring in cash from the outside," Wirth said.

item.title: GRÁFICOS Tarifas de petroleros tocan récords tras ataques a buques de Irán y EEUU
item.description: El costo del transporte de crudo en los petroleros más grandes alcanzó máximos históricos esta semana, tras la mayor oleada de ataques contra el tránsito marítimo desde que comenzó la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán a finales de febrero.
item.dc:creator: Enes Tunagur
item.content:encoded: El costo del transporte de crudo en los petroleros más grandes alcanzó máximos históricos esta semana, tras la mayor oleada de ataques contra el tránsito marítimo desde que comenzó la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán a finales de febrero. La tarifa de transporte de los superpetroleros —también denominados buques de gran capacidad para el transporte de crudo o VLCC— que cargan petróleo en el golfo de Omán para su envío a China alcanzó cerca de 450 según el índice Worldscale, lo que equivale a unos 11,5 dólares por barril, según datos de la Bolsa del Báltico. Se trata del nivel más alto desde que se introdujo esta tarifa a principios de este año, tras el inicio de la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán. El repunte de las tarifas pone de manifiesto cómo el conflicto de Oriente Medio está repercutiendo en la economía en general. Si las alzas persisten, podrían agravar las presiones inflacionistas y elevar más el costo para empresas y consumidores, que ya se enfrentan a la incertidumbre derivada de la escalada del conflicto. Irán dijo el miércoles que había atacado diez buques cerca del estrecho de Ormuz, después de que Estados Unidos hundió cinco petroleros iraníes. Los hutíes de Yemen, alineados con Irán, llegaron el viernes a la estratégica isla de Perim, en el estrecho de Mandeb, informaron a Reuters cuatro fuentes del Gobierno yemení, lo que podría reforzar su control sobre una de las rutas marítimas más importantes del mundo. "Los nuevos ataques entre la Marina estadounidense e Irán siguen impulsando las tarifas de flete en el golfo (Pérsico) a nuevos máximos", dijo Ioannis Papadimitriou, analista de Vortexa. El mayor riesgo que supone operar en la región también está impulsando al alza las tarifas de flete en el golfo de Omán, por el temor a represalias iraníes, lo que, naturalmente, reduce el número de petroleros disponibles en la zona, añadió Papadimitrou . La reciente escalada militar en la región también está teniendo un efecto dominó más amplio, ya que las tarifas de los VLCC en la ruta de África Occidental a Asia también alcanzaron máximos históricos.

item.title: Manifestantes não jogaram ovos em carro de Lula em SP; vídeo foi gravado na Albânia
item.description: Um vídeo que mostra manifestantes jogando ovos em um carro foi gravado durante um protesto na Albânia em julho deste ano, e não em uma visita recente do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a São José do Rio Preto (SP), como afirmam posts nas redes sociais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo que mostra manifestantes jogando ovos em um carro foi gravado durante um protesto na Albânia em julho deste ano, e não em uma visita recente do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a São José do Rio Preto (SP), como afirmam posts nas redes sociais. Aqui estão os principais detalhes: “Lula muito bem recebido em São José do Rio Preto”, diz uma publicação no Facebook que reproduz a filmagem. O vídeo circula nas redes sociais desde o final de julho. O canal de TV Al Arabiya, da Arábia Saudita, publicou uma versão mais longa da gravação no dia 24 daquele mês. Segundo o Al Arabiya, as imagens mostram um protesto em Tirana, capital da Albânia, contra a construção de um resort de luxo planejado por uma empresa ligada a Jared Kushner, genro de Donald Trump, em uma área ambientalmente sensível da costa do mar Adriático. Já Lula visitou São José do Rio Preto mais de um mês depois da manifestação, no último dia 5 . Não houve registros de incidentes durante a passagem do presidente pela cidade. Pelo Google Street View , a Reuters confirmou que as imagens foram feitas em Tirana -- o mesmo prédio , por exemplo, aparece nos registros da ferramenta e no vídeo checado. No vídeo, também aparecem placas de veículo e de trânsito no modelo europeu , e não no brasileiro . VEREDICTO: Legenda errada. Foi na Albânia, e não durante a visita de Lula a São José do Rio Preto, um protesto em que manifestantes lançaram ovos em um carro. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: US House to vote on Russia sanctions backed by late Senator Graham
item.description: The U.S. House of Representatives will begin consideration next week of a sweeping Russia sanctions bill championed by the late Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, which has passed the Senate but faces stiff opposition from House Democrats.
item.dc:creator: Patricia Zengerle
item.content:encoded: The U.S. House of Representatives will begin consideration next week of a sweeping Russia sanctions bill championed by the late Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, which has passed the Senate but faces stiff opposition from House Democrats. The House Rules Committee said it scheduled a meeting to consider the measure for Monday afternoon. Approval by the Republican-majority Rules Committee would pave the way for a vote in the full chamber later in the week. Graham, a South Carolina Republican who died in July, was among Ukraine's most outspoken allies in Congress. His bill aims to increase economic pressure on Moscow over its invasion of Ukraine by sanctioning Russian officials and authorizing stiff tariffs on China, India and other countries to reduce their dependence on Russian oil and gas. The [USN:L1N4431OK TEXT:"Senate voted"] 86-11 last month to pass the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026." However, the support from both Republicans and Democrats that propelled the bill through the Senate might not be enough to secure House passage. Some lawmakers and industries worry that new tariff powers for Republican President Donald Trump could raise costs for U.S. importers and consumers. Some Republican lawmakers are also concerned about political blowback ahead of November's mid-term elections.

item.title: Houthis reach strategic Perim island in Bab el-Mandeb Strait, tighten grip on vital shipping route
item.description: If Houthis gain control of Strait, it could give Iran a big advantage in its war with US, reducing supplies through a second major transit corridor & sending oil prices surging.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
-->

Houthis reach strategic Perim island in Bab el-Mandeb Strait, tighten grip on vital shipping route

If Houthis gain control of Strait, it could give Iran a big advantage in its war with US, reducing supplies through a second major transit corridor & sending oil prices surging.

Reuters

11 September, 2026 09:16 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

A satellite image shows black smoke rising from an area of Saudi Arabia’s East-West oil pipeline south of Medina, Hejaz Region, Saudi Arabia September 10, 2026. | European Union/Copernicus Sentinel-3/Handout via REUTERS

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

Aden/Dubai: Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis reached the strategic island of Perim in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait on Friday, four Yemeni government sources told Reuters, moving to tighten their grip on a vital global shipping route in the widening Middle East war.

Earlier, two sources from the Saudi-backed, internationally recognised Yemeni government said its forces had pulled out of Perim and that the Houthis had also taken the mainland Red Sea coastal town of Dhubab, which faces the island.

If the Houthis gain control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which is on the opposite side of the Arabian Peninsula from the Strait of Hormuz, it could give their backer Iran a critical advantage in its war with the U.S., reducing supplies through a second major transit corridor and sending oil prices surging.

Show Full Article

Saudi Arabia, the world’s largest oil exporter and a close U.S. ally, has relied on the Red Sea route since the Iran conflict effectively closed Hormuz, through which a fifth of global oil used to flow.

In the wider war between Iran and the U.S., the two sides have carried out a wave of tit-for-tat attacks this week on shipping in the Gulf, while President Donald Trump has jacked up economic pressure on Tehran. Diplomacy is largely stalled.

Iran confirmed on Friday that its representatives and those of Iraq and the Gulf Arab states would meet in Oman on Monday to resume discussions on safe commercial shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz. The Financial Times originally reported the planned meeting.

SMOKE SEEN ABOVE SAUDI EAST-WEST OIL PIPELINE In a further potentially significant development for Riyadh, satellite imagery showed smoke on Thursday in the vicinity of Saudi Arabia’s East-West oil pipeline, which has become a vital means for the kingdom to divert its crude exports from Hormuz.

There was no confirmation from Saudi Arabia of any incident in the area. The Saudi government media office and state oil giant Aramco did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the smoke visible in the imagery verified by Reuters.

Aramco has used the East-West pipeline to ramp up crude flows from Saudi Arabia’s eastern coast to the Red Sea after U.S.-Israeli airstrikes on Iran began six months ago, prompting Tehran to effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz.

Saudi crude supply fell 2.3 million barrels per day on the month in August to 6 million bpd, the lowest level in more than three decades, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, partly due to the targeting of ships transiting the Bab el-Mandeb Strait by groups linked to Yemen’s Houthis .

Global oil prices were on track to end the week above $100 a barrel for the first time since mid-May.

Vessels recorded transiting the Strait of Hormuz fell to seven on Thursday from 11 the previous day, preliminary ship-tracking data showed on Friday, well below the 10-day average of 10.

The Houthis ‘ military spokesperson, Yahya Saree, said on Telegram that maritime navigation remained safe for all shipping except Saudi vessels subject to a previously announced ban.

“We will continue to enforce blockade for blockade and escalation for escalation until the aggression stops and the blockade on our people is lifted,” he said on Friday, referring to Saudi attacks on Yemen.

YEMENI GOVERNMENT FORCES PLOT COUNTER-OFFENSIVE Yemeni government forces indicated they would try to retake areas captured by the Houthi militants in their lightning offensive this week along the Red Sea coastline.

They announced they would deploy weapons and aircraft to eliminate any movement of the “terrorist” Houthi militias in strategic areas, including the road leading to the coastal city of Mocha, which the militant group captured on Thursday along with the Red Sea islands of Hanish.

Military spokesman Colonel Majed al-Nazili called on civilians to avoid using the route between the city of Taiz and Mocha and steer clear of equipment belonging to the Houthis , mountain fighters who withstood years of devastating Saudi airstrikes during Yemen’s civil war.

Reuters reported on Thursday that the dramatic Houthi advance down Yemen’s Red Sea coast this week came with direct guidance from Iran’s Revolutionary Guards seeking to open a new front in Tehran’s war with the U.S., according to Yemeni government, Iranian and regional sources.

Iran told the Houthis last week to escalate their attacks on Saudi Arabia and promised more funding, weapons and senior officers to help them do so, two Iranian sources said.

While Iran describes the Houthis as an ally, it publicly denies giving them military direction, saying they are “not a proxy”.

SAUDI CROWN PRINCE ASKED TRUMP FOR MILITARY HELP, SOURCES SAY Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman called Trump at least twice on Thursday to request U.S. military help in fighting the Houthis , two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday, confirming an earlier report by Axios.

In the end, Washington told Riyadh it was not willing to take direct military action for now but would help with intelligence sharing and targeting, the two sources said.

The White House did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The Saudi embassy in Washington declined to comment.

The war has sent Trump’s approval ratings to a record low ahead of the November midterm elections in the United States.

(Catherine Cartier reported from Beirut; Additional reporting by Samia Nakhoul in Ankara, Maha El Dahan in Dubai and Jacob Bogage in Washington; Writing by Michael Georgy and Gareth Jones; Editing by Aidan Lewis)

item.title: スイス中銀総裁「金利巡る情勢変化」、市場は利上げ観測にシフト
item.description: [スイス、ルツェルン １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[スイス、ルツェルン １１日 ロイター] - スイス国立銀行（ＳＮＢ、中央銀行）のシュレーゲル総裁は１１日、米国や、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が今週利上げを決定したユーロ圏の動向に言及し「金利を巡る情勢は変化した」と発言した。エネルギー価格の高騰がインフレを押し上げていることを踏まえ、市場の観測が利上げ方向にシフトしているとの見解を示した。

スイス中部ルツェルンで経済団体が主催したイベントで講演したシュレーゲル氏は、エネルギー価格の高騰は他の業種での物価上昇や賃金上昇のリスクにつながると説明。スイスでは、８月のインフレ率が予想を上回って上昇したものの、二次的な影響は今のところ顕著ではないとの見方を示した。

スイスフランの為替水準は経済にとって課題であるものの、他の国・地域に比べてスイスのインフレ率が低く推移しており、実質的には２０２０年以降、おおむね安定していると指摘した。

item.title: Red Wings' Dylan Larkin reporting to camp, not returning as captain
item.description: Detroit Red Wings center Dylan Larkin, who requested a trade following last season, will report to training camp next week but will not return as captain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Detroit Red Wings center Dylan Larkin, who requested a trade following last season, will report to training camp next week but will not return as captain. The team and Larkin issued statements Friday about how they will move forward when camp opens on Thursday. "We look forward to seeing Dylan and the rest of his teammates at Little Caesars Arena for the start of training camp as we prepare for the upcoming season," the team said. Larkin, a Michigan native, has spent his entire 11-year NHL career in Detroit. The Red Wings, however, are mired in a 10-year playoff drought, and he has appeared in only five playoff games in his career. Times are changing in Detroit. Winger Patrick Kane returned to the Chicago Blackhawks in July in free agency. That same month, the Red Wings said Steve Yzerman would move from general manager to a senior adviser position. Without a GM in place, no decision has been made on Larkin's trade request. He reportedly has given the Red Wings a list of teams for which he would waive his no-trade clause. He is playing on an eight-year, $69.6 million contract that extends through the 2030-31 season. The changes also include a shift in captaincy. Larkin had served in the role since 2021. "The Red Wings will begin the 2026-27 season without a captain being named," the team said in its statement. "Any further discussions or decisions regarding this topic will be made once new hockey operations leadership is in place." Larkin, 30, is waiting to hear about the new leadership as the new season approaches. "Over the past couple of weeks, Red Wings leadership and I have had several in-depth discussions. I've appreciated those candid conversations, and I will be at training camp with my teammates," Larkin said in his statement. "When new leadership is in place, we'll talk further about the direction of the team. We will keep those conversations private, and I will keep my focus on the season ahead and on the guys in that room." Larkin recorded a career-high 34 goals to go along with 33 assists in 74 games in the 2025-26 season. A gold medalist on the 2026 United States Olympic team in Italy, Larkin has totaled 643 points (276 goals, 367 assists) in 808 career games since he was selected by Detroit with the 15th overall pick of the 2014 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: D John Klingberg retires after 700 games with 6 teams
item.description: Defenseman John Klingberg announced his retirement on Friday after 700 NHL games with six teams.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Defenseman John Klingberg announced his retirement on Friday after 700 NHL games with six teams. The 34-year-old Swede played his first eight seasons (2014-22) with the Dallas Stars, earning an All-Rookie nod in 2014-15 and making the All-Star team in 2017-18. He recorded 27 points (10 goals, 17 assists) in 56 games last season with the San Jose Sharks. Klingberg collected 443 points (92 goals, 351 assists) with the Stars, Anaheim Ducks, Minnesota Wild, Toronto Maple Leafs, Edmonton Oilers and Sharks. Dallas drafted him in the fifth round in 2010. He added 43 points (nine goals, 34 assists) in 82 playoff games. He lost in the Stanley Cup Final with Dallas against the Tampa Bay Lightning in six games in 2020, and with Edmonton against the Florida Panthers in six games in 2025. Klingberg helped Sweden win world championship gold medals in 2017 and 2018. --Field Level Media

item.title: Arbeitnehmer dringen Volkswagen-Vorstand zu Gesprächen
item.description: Die Arbeitnehmervertreter bei Volkswagen pochen angesichts der Sparpläne bei Europas größtem Autobauer auf eine Einhaltung der Tarifeinigung von 2024 und holen dazu den Vorstand an den Gesprächstisch. Der Verhandlungsführer der IG Metall in Niedersachsen, Thorsten Gröger, sagte am Freitag, die Gewerkschaft habe sich dazu entschieden, eine Regelung aus dem Tarifvertrag von Dezember 2024 zu nutzen. "Wir fordern das Unternehmen auf, an den Tisch zu kommen und uns zu erklären, wie der Tarifvertrag eingehalten wird." Dabei gehe es vor allem um die verbindlich vereinbarten Investitionen in neue Modelle, Zukunftsprodukte und moderne Produktionsverfahren.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Arbeitnehmervertreter bei Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) pochen angesichts der Sparpläne bei Europas größtem Autobauer auf eine Einhaltung der Tarifeinigung von 2024 und holen dazu den Vorstand an den Gesprächstisch. Der Verhandlungsführer der IG Metall in Niedersachsen, Thorsten Gröger, sagte am Freitag, die Gewerkschaft habe sich dazu entschieden, eine Regelung aus dem Tarifvertrag von Dezember 2024 zu nutzen. "Wir fordern das Unternehmen auf, an den Tisch zu kommen und uns zu erklären, wie der Tarifvertrag eingehalten wird." Dabei gehe es vor allem um die verbindlich vereinbarten Investitionen in neue Modelle, Zukunftsprodukte und moderne Produktionsverfahren. Ein Volkswagen-Sprecher erklärte, das Unternehmen begrüße den Schritt der IG Metall ausdrücklich. "Damit schaffen wir die Grundlage und Voraussetzung für Gespräche, für die wir selbstverständlich zur Verfügung stehen." Aus Unternehmenssicht sei dieser Schritt nötig, um die 2024 beschlossenen Maßnahmen konsequent umzusetzen und um sich gleichzeitig den zusätzlichen Herausforderungen zu stellen, vor denen die gesamte Automobilindustrie stehe. Mit dem Ziehen der Klausel sei keine Kündigung der Vereinbarung verbunden, betonte IG-Metall-Chefunterhändler Gröger. Die Gespräche sollten noch in diesem Quartal stattfinden. Kommt es zu keiner Einigung, kann nach Gewerkschaftsangaben die Schlichtungsstelle angerufen werden. VW-Betriebsratschefin Daniela Cavallo sagte, die Aussagen der Vorstandsmitglieder bei den Betriebsversammlungen hätten eher für noch mehr Verunsicherung gesorgt. Die Belegschaften in Zwickau und Emden erfüllten ihre Zusagen, die 2024 zur Bedingung für weitere Fahrzeugprojekte gemacht worden seien. "Diese Verunsicherung kann für unsere Belegschaft an den Standorten nicht weitergehen." Es könne nicht sein, dass ein Vertrag einfach beiseitegewischt werde. "Jetzt muss der Vorstand liefern." Zugleich forderte sie die Politik auf, das Unternehmen zu unterstützen. Sie müsse für die Rahmenbedingungen sorgen, damit es einen fairen Wettbewerb gebe. Derzeit würden viele Themen um die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der deutschen Wirtschaft auf die Sozialpartner abgeladen. "Das ist ein Trugschluss", betonte Cavallo. Die Autobranche konkurriere mit chinesischen Herstellern, die in ihrem Heimatmarkt stark subventioniert würden und deswegen Preise aufrufen könnten, mit denen europäische Hersteller nicht mithalten könnten. "ERWARTEN, DASS GESCHLOSSENE VERTRÄGE EINGEHALTEN WERDEN" Im Dezember 2024 hatten sich Arbeitnehmer und Vorstand nach monatelangem Ringen auf einen Tarifvertrag geeinigt. Dabei einigten sich beide Seiten auf den Abbau von 35.000 Arbeitsplätzen. Im Gegenzug sagte der Vorstand unter anderem eine Beschäftigungsgarantie bis Ende 2030 und Modelle für die Standorte Emden, Zwickau und Hannover zu. Der Vertrag kann frühestens zum Jahresende 2030 gekündigt werden, enthält allerdings eine Revisionsklausel. Darin ist festgehalten, dass beide Seiten einmal pro Quartal ein Überprüfungsgespräch beantragen können, wenn sich die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen geändert haben. Bei Streitfällen kann demnach die Schlichtungsstelle angerufen werden. Derzeit steht Volkswagen erneut vor dem Abbau zehntausender Arbeitsplätze. Der Aufsichtsrat von Europas größtem Autobauer hatte sich vergangene Woche überraschend auf ein Sanierungskonzept geeinigt, mit dem der Vorstand um Oliver Blume die Rendite bis 2030 auf neun Prozent steigern will. Dabei sollen rund 50.000 Stellen weltweit wegfallen, vier deutsche Werke stehen auf dem Prüfstand. Eine Entscheidung, ob die Fertigung in den Elektrowerken in Emden und Zwickau sowie im Nutzfahrzeuge-Werk in Hannover und in der Audi-Fabrik in Neckarsulm ab 2031 auslaufen soll, wurde jedoch vertagt.

item.title: FIFA gives ex-Maldives FA chief lifetime ban for misusing COVID funds
item.description: Former Football Association of Maldives (FAM) President Bassam Adeel Jaleel has been banned for life from football-related activities for misusing COVID-19 relief funds for his personal benefit, world soccer's governing body FIFA said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Football Association of Maldives (FAM) President Bassam Adeel Jaleel has been banned for life from football-related activities for misusing COVID-19 relief funds for his personal benefit, world soccer's governing body FIFA said on Friday. Jaleel had previously been provisionally suspended amid an investigation into allegations of money laundering, embezzlement and corruption. FIFA has also ordered Jaleel to pay a fine of one million Swiss francs ($1.23 million). Jaleel could not be reached for comment. Local media reported Jaleel is serving prison sentences totalling 32 years for depositing FIFA funds into his own account and using funds from FIFA's COVID-19 Relief Plan to purchase an apartment. Maldives news outlet Sun Online said he had been transferred to house arrest on the medical board's recommendation last month. He was previously transferred to house arrest in March but returned to prison after a public backlash. FIFA said the FAM's former director of finance and administration, Mohamed Ageel, had also been banned for 10 years. Ageel has been ordered to pay a fine of 100,000 Swiss francs for "facilitating and concealing misuse of FIFA funds, using falsified documentation and failing to cooperate with FIFA's independent Ethics Committee," FIFA added. FIFA also announced a lifetime ban for former president of the Montserrat Football Association (MFA), Vincent Cassell, and a fine of one million Swiss francs for "abuse of position, systemic conflicts of interest, misuse of FIFA and MFA funds and conduct affecting the physical and mental integrity of MFA staff members." The MFA's former General Secretary Tandica Hughes was banned for 15 years and fined 150,000 Swiss francs for "personally benefiting from and facilitating improper transactions involving FIFA and MFA resources," FIFA said. Reuters has contacted both the Maldives and Montserrat FAs for comment. ($1 = 0.8144 Swiss francs)

item.title: ＥＣＢ総裁、データに基づき理事会ごとに政策判断と改めて表明
item.description: [ブリュッセル １１日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は１１日、同中銀は今後数カ月間、データ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ総裁、データに基づき理事会ごとに政策判断と改めて表明 0:20 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁。9月10日撮影。REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

[ブリュッセル　１１日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は１１日、同中銀は今後数カ月間、データに基づいて理事会ごとに判断を下していくとの考えを改めて示した。

ＥＣＢは１０日に開いた理事会で政策金利を０．２５％ポイント引き上げると決定した。利上げは予想通りで、今年２回目。

フランスの銀行ＢＰＣＥがパリで開催したイベントで、総裁はこの決定について「２７人で構成される理事会において、誰も異議を唱えることのない、全会一致の決定だった」と述べた。

item.title: Grupos ligados a Trump e Musk injetam milhões para impulsionar republicanos em disputas eleitorais decisivas nos EUA
item.description: Os dois maiores financiadores de candidatos do Partido Republicano nas eleições legislativas de meio de mandato dos Estados Unidos em 2026 – o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e o bilionário Elon Musk – finalmente abriram os cofres a menos de oito semanas do dia da votação.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Dawn Kopecki
item.content:encoded: Os dois maiores financiadores de candidatos do Partido Republicano nas eleições legislativas de meio de mandato dos Estados Unidos em 2026 – o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e o bilionário Elon Musk – finalmente abriram os cofres a menos de oito semanas do dia da votação. Com os republicanos diante da perspectiva de perder o controle de pelo menos uma das Casas do Congresso, e pesquisas indicando que eleitores democratas estão mais motivados a votar, um grupo ligado a Trump começou a gastar dezenas de milhões de dólares para reservar blocos de tempo para anúncios de TV em disputas acirradas para cadeiras no Congresso. Trump, cujo índice de aprovação está estagnado no nível mais baixo de sua carreira política, disse a repórteres na semana passada que planejava destinar entre US$400 milhões e US$500 milhões para impulsionar candidatos republicanos nas eleições legislativas de meio de mandato. O comitê de ação política republicano afiliado a Trump, “No Going Back”, garantiu mais de US$24,9 milhões em tempo de propaganda em seis Estados decisivos: Alasca, Geórgia, Michigan, Carolina do Norte, New Hampshire e Ohio, de acordo com a empresa de pesquisa de propaganda política AdImpact. Além disso, o “Musk’s America PAC”, de Musk, e o principal braço de arrecadação de fundos de Trump, a “MAGA Inc.”, injetaram nos últimos dias US$2,4 milhões e US$10 milhões, respectivamente, na disputa por uma vaga no Senado dos EUA no Texas, onde o procurador-geral estadual Ken Paxton corre o risco de se tornar o primeiro republicano a perder para um democrata em uma eleição estadual naquele Estado em décadas. Cerca de US$6,9 milhões desse montante estão sendo gastos em anúncios de ataque contra o deputado estadual democrata James Talarico, que aparece 2,1 pontos percentuais à frente de Paxton na média das pesquisas compiladas pelo “Silver Bulletin”, de Nate Silver. “Os republicanos agora precisam gastar dinheiro de verdade para defender um mapa eleitoral ampliado”, disse o estrategista republicano Brad Dayspring, da Purple Strategies, em Alexandria, Virgínia. “Quando de repente você precisa investir milhões no Texas, o fato de o presidente Trump e Musk abrirem seus bolsos dá aos republicanos a capacidade de reforçar disputas vulneráveis sem esgotar recursos do restante do mapa.” O America PAC, de Musk, espera desempenhar um papel importante nos esforços republicanos para aumentar a participação eleitoral em Estados-chave, com gastos em campanhas de porta a porta, publicidade digital e mala direta antes da eleição de 3 de novembro. Ele já gastou mais de US$7 milhões em publicidade digital, mensagens de texto, ligações para eleitores, correspondências e outros materiais impressos, segundo registros federais. Um porta-voz do grupo se recusou a comentar. NOVA ALIANÇA DE ARRECADAÇÃO DE FUNDOS O fundo de campanha de Trump para as eleições de meio de mandato está apoiando o novo grupo de financiamento “No Going Back”, segundo uma pessoa a par do assunto que pediu para não ser identificada. Não está claro quanto desse fundo será alocado por meio desse novo grupo. Embora a MAGA Inc. de Trump e o “No Going Back” ainda não estejam formalmente afiliados entre si, eles compartilham o mesmo tesoureiro – Charles Gantt –, número de telefone e endereço na mesma empresa em Massachusetts. Gantt, a MAGA Inc. e o “No Going Back” não responderam aos pedidos de comentário. O jornal New York Times informou que o “No Going Back” gastou US$49 milhões em reservas de publicidade somente na terça e na quarta-feira. Não está claro por que o novo grupo de financiamento eleitoral, registrado na Comissão Eleitoral Federal em 1º de setembro, foi criado, mas o estrategista republicano Ron Bonjean afirmou que isso ajuda a distanciar Trump e seu movimento MAGA das doações de campanha, à medida que os eleitores se desiludem com o presidente. Qualquer publicidade do novo grupo será atribuída ao No Going Back PAC, em vez de à MAGA Inc., um nome intimamente ligado à marca política de Trump. “É uma estratégia brilhante porque retira o MAGA do nome. Retira qualquer afiliação a Trump do nome. Tem um nome inofensivo com o qual ninguém vai se importar, ao contrário da MAGA Inc., que poderia afastar os eleitores independentes imediatamente”, disse Bonjean, sócio da empresa bipartidária de relações públicas Rokk Solutions, em Washington. O novo grupo utilizou alguns dos mesmos fornecedores da MAGA Inc. para realizar seu trabalho e, em agosto, alguns funcionários da MAGA Inc. começaram a sinalizar aos republicanos sua intenção de criar um novo grupo de financiamento eleitoral, de acordo com a pessoa a par da operação. O momento do registro do “No Going Back” adiará a divulgação completa de seus doadores até o final de outubro, de acordo com as regras da comissão eleitoral. Trump encerrou o primeiro dia da primeira convenção de meio de mandato do Partido Republicano, realizada em Dallas na quarta-feira, propondo pagar a cada adulto dos EUA um “dividendo Trump” de US$5.000 caso o partido vença as eleições para o Congresso. Não ficou imediatamente claro como os pagamentos de US$5.000 funcionariam ou se seriam legais. (Reportagem de Bo Erickson, em Washington, e Dawn Kopecki, em Nova York)

item.title: ロシア中銀、政策金利14％に据え置き 「物価上昇圧力高まる」
item.description:
Elena Fabrichnaya Gleb Bryanski
[モスクワ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elena Fabrichnaya　Gleb Bryanski

[モスクワ １１日 ロイター] - ロシア中央銀行は１１日、主要政策金利を１４％に据え置くことを決めた。２０２５年に減速が鮮明になったロシア経済は、２６年にわずかなプラス成長にとどまると見込まれており、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト調査で据え置きが予想されていた。中銀は「ここ数カ月で物価上昇圧力は著しく高まった」と表明した。

経済界は、金利が１２％を下回らない限りは経済が回復しないと主張し、利下げを求めていた。一方、中銀は、年初の時点と比べて投資は回復しつつあると反論している。

６月に製油所へのドローン攻撃を受けて燃料不足に陥り、価格が高騰したことを受け、鈍化傾向にあったインフレ率は再び上昇している。ウクライナ侵攻から４年半が経過する中、ロシアでは議会選を約１週間後に控える。

中銀は、価格上昇の主な要因として、ウクライナによる製油所や物流施設への攻撃を挙げ、「特定の分野での一時的な生産能力の低下による影響」と指摘した。一方、ロシアの財政赤字は８月に国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比２．５％と、前月のＧＤＰ比２．８％から縮小した。足元のエネルギー価格の高騰により、ロシア財政が恩恵を受けるとの見方もある。

item.title: South Africa post convincing win to take ODI series against Namibia
item.description: South African opening batsman Connor Esterhuizen scored a maiden One Day International century on Friday to help his side to another one-sided victory over Namibia in the second of their three-game series, securing a 2-0 lead with a 157-run triumph.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South African opening batsman Connor Esterhuizen scored a maiden One Day International century on Friday to help his side to another one-sided victory over Namibia in the second of their three-game series, securing a 2-0 lead with a 157-run triumph. Esterhuizen scored 119 as South Africa were put into bat and compiled 335-9 in their 50 overs before dismissing their hosts for 178 at the Namibia Cricket Ground in Windhoek. Esterhuizen and Tony de Zorzi, who made 79 runs, put on 183 runs for the second wicket to lay the foundation for their team's success while Namibia quick Jack Brassell took 4-64. In reply, Namibia's opening three batsmen were dismissed without scoring and they were teetering at 32-5 in the 11th over before captain Gerhard Erasmus offered some resistance, scoring 68. But they were dismissed with 8.1 overs remaining, well short of the target. South Africa's opening bowlers Duan Jansen (4-31) and Ethan Bosch (3-27) did the early damage. The visitors also had a comfortable victory in their first meeting on Wednesday, winning by 99 runs on the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method in a rain-affected clash. The two countries, who are co-hosting next year's World Cup along with Zimbabwe, will on Sunday complete the last game of their first-ever ODI series against each other.

item.title: Modi e Putin concordam em fortalecer parceria entre Índia e Rússia na véspera da cúpula do Brics
item.description: A Índia informou nesta sexta-feira que o primeiro-ministro do país, Narendra Modi, e o presidente da Rússia, Vladimir Putin, concordaram em fortalecer ainda mais a relação especial entre os dois países em conversações que abrangeram áreas como energia e defesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Índia informou nesta sexta-feira que o primeiro-ministro do país, Narendra Modi, e o presidente da Rússia, Vladimir Putin, concordaram em fortalecer ainda mais a relação especial entre os dois países em conversações que abrangeram áreas como energia e defesa. Nova Délhi está empenhada em um equilíbrio diplomático, ao tentar manter laços fortes com os Estados Unidos, os países árabes do Golfo Pérsico, a Rússia, o Irã e Israel, enquanto sofre o impacto das interrupções no transporte marítimo e no comércio decorrentes das guerras na Ucrânia e no Irã. O encontro foi o segundo em duas semanas entre os dois líderes. Ele ocorreu na véspera da cúpula anual dos líderes do Brics na capital indiana, da qual devem participar o presidente da China, Xi Jinping, e o presidente do Irã, Masoud Pezeshkian, entre outros. O bloco busca aumentar sua visibilidade, mesmo com seus membros divididos em relação à guerra no Irã. Modi e Putin “compartilharam perspectivas sobre... os conflitos na Ásia Ocidental e na região do Mar Negro, que afetaram o comércio marítimo e a segurança dos marítimos indianos”, informou um comunicado do Ministério das Relações Exteriores da Índia. Modi reiterou que os conflitos devem ser resolvidos por meio do diálogo e da diplomacia e que a Índia está pronta para ajudar nos esforços de paz, acrescentou o comunicado. “Os dois líderes concordaram em continuar empenhados no esforço para fortalecer ainda mais a parceria estratégica especial e privilegiada entre os dois países”, afirmou o comunicado do Ministério das Relações Exteriores. LAÇOS ENERGÉTICOS RESILIENTES A Índia, juntamente com a China, é uma das maiores compradoras de petróleo russo, o que é visto como uma forma de ajudar Moscou a reabastecer seu orçamento desde que lançou sua invasão em grande escala à Ucrânia em 2022 e foi alvo de sanções ocidentais abrangentes. A Índia tem procurado resistir à pressão para reduzir o comércio, argumentando que sua grande população e economia precisam de suprimentos de energia seguros, acessíveis e confiáveis. Nova Délhi também afirmou que o conflito na Ucrânia só pode ser resolvido por meio do diálogo e da diplomacia, e não pela interrupção, por parte de alguns países, do comércio de energia, metais ou fertilizantes com a Rússia. A participação da Rússia nas importações indianas de petróleo bruto aumentou em 2026, atingindo um recorde de 51% em julho, à medida que as interrupções no abastecimento do Oriente Médio aumentaram a dependência das refinarias indianas do petróleo russo. Essa participação provavelmente diminuiu em agosto, à medida que a China intensificou as compras de petróleo russo, segundo reportagens da mídia indiana. Modi disse, nesta sexta-feira, que presenteou Putin com uma tradução para o russo do Thirukkural, um texto clássico reverenciado na língua tâmil da Índia, composto por 1.330 dísticos sobre virtude, governança e amor, atribuído ao poeta e filósofo Thiruvalluvar. Os dois líderes também visitaram uma feira industrial Índia-Rússia que exibia empresas russas das áreas de tecnologia, inteligência artificial, aviação, espaço, ciência nuclear, engenharia pesada, mineração e setor bancário. A Índia e a Rússia afirmaram que pretendem elevar o comércio bilateral para US$100 bilhões até 2030, partindo de quase US$70 bilhões em 2024-2025. (Reportagem de Saurabh Sharma e Shilpa Jamkhandikar)

item.title: ChatGPT gerou depoimentos falsos em recurso de caso de homicídio nos EUA, diz tribunal
item.description: Um advogado de defesa que estava recorrendo da condenação de seu cliente por homicídio apresentou uma petição contendo depoimentos policiais falsos e testemunhas fabricadas pelo ChatGPT, da OpenAI, informou a Suprema Corte do Novo México.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Um advogado de defesa que estava recorrendo da condenação de seu cliente por homicídio apresentou uma petição contendo depoimentos policiais falsos e testemunhas fabricadas pelo ChatGPT, da OpenAI, informou a Suprema Corte do Novo México. O tribunal multou na quarta-feira o advogado, Stephen Aarons, e o considerou culpado por desacato por não ter verificado a exatidão do documento apresentado ao tribunal. Aarons afirmou ter preparado o documento com ajuda da IA. O documento “continha depoimentos falsos de testemunhas totalmente inventadas”, afirmou o tribunal. O tribunal também disse que Aarons “demonstrou falta de remorso e falta de preocupação com seu cliente”. Os juízes multaram Aarons em US$5.000 e disseram que o encaminharão a um conselho disciplinar da Ordem dos Advogados para investigação. Em declaração à Reuters, Aarons afirmou que havia usado o ChatGPT para resumir os autos do julgamento quando concordou em assumir o recurso do réu no ano passado, e que não compreendia até que ponto a IA poderia “inventar” fatos. “Estou arrependido, mas tenho esperança de que o conselho disciplinar leve em consideração que foi um erro involuntário”, disse. “É uma lição aprendida para todos os profissionais que dependem dessa tecnologia poderosa, mas às vezes instável.” A OpenAI não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. A sanção do tribunal é o mais recente de um número crescente de casos em que juízes estaduais e federais puniram advogados por apresentarem documentos judiciais gerados por ferramentas de IA sem verificá-los adequadamente. Dezenas de advogados foram punidos por apresentar petições nas quais a IA inventou citações de casos ou citou erroneamente a lei. O documento apresentado por Aarons parece ter ido além, contendo depoimentos de testemunhas fabricados em um recurso criminal. Aarons, um advogado particular com sede em Santa Fé, estava cuidando do recurso de Oscar Renee Sandoval, que se declarou inocente no caso de assassinato da mãe de seus filhos, antes de ser condenado e sentenciado no ano passado à prisão perpétua. O recurso ainda está pendente e foi atribuído, em 2 de setembro, a Kim Chavez Cook, uma defensora pública do Novo México. Cook se recusou a comentar. A Promotoria do condado de Doña Ana também se recusou a comentar. A Suprema Corte estadual ordenou no mês passado que Aarons explicasse como o material forjado -- que, segundo a corte, parecia incluir “declarações fictícias de que o atirador usava calças escuras e uma camisa branca” -- foi incluído em sua petição inicial no recurso. Aarons disse ao tribunal, em uma audiência realizada em 21 de agosto, que inseriu uma transcrição gerada por computador e outros materiais do caso no ChatGPT, presumindo que o sistema geraria “um resumo à prova de balas”. Os juízes mostraram-se incrédulos diante do fato de Aarons não estar plenamente ciente de como a IA pode cometer erros. “Advogado, o senhor assiste ao noticiário? O senhor ouve rádio? O senhor lê alguma coisa sobre o que está acontecendo no mundo?”, perguntou a juíza C. Shannon Bacon na audiência. “Porque o problema de advogados confiarem em alucinações da IA é uma notícia de primeira página todos os dias.”

item.title: PE firm Waterland ends alliance with Giacom in Gamma takeover pursuit
item.description: Dutch private equity firm Waterland said on Friday it is no longer in concert with UK-based Giacom to make an offer for British telecom company Gamma Communications .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dutch private equity firm Waterland said on Friday it is no longer in concert with UK-based Giacom to make an offer for British telecom company Gamma Communications (GAMA.L) . Here are some more details: Gamma agreed to a 1,120 pence per share offer from private equity firm Epiris [USN:L4N44T0JJ TEXT:"earlier this month"], capping months of takeover talks. Waterland said it is continuing to consider its interest in Gamma, but that there can be no certainty of a firm offer. Gamma's shares were down 2.8% at 1141p at 1443 GMT. The telecommunications company has attracted interest from several private equity firms this year, including [USN:L6N42K0VK TEXT:"Oakley Capital"] and [USN:L6N42W0LL TEXT:"Providence Equity Partners"], which withdrew their bids in June. In [USN:L6N44I0NL TEXT:"August"], Gamma said Giacom, a telecom service company, is acting in concert with Waterland relating to a possible deal in which Giacom would buy certain business units of Gamma. The Sunday Times reported on Monday that Waterland could make an offer for Gamma that could exceed Epiris' £1.08 billion ($1.46 billion) bid. Giacom could not be reached immediately for comment. ($1 = 0.7392 pounds)

item.title: Netherlands signs intent to buy Saab GlobalEye surveillance jet
item.description: The Netherlands has signed a letter of intent with Sweden to acquire a Saab GlobalEye advanced military surveillance aircraft, the Dutch government said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Netherlands has signed a letter of intent with Sweden to acquire a Saab GlobalEye advanced military surveillance aircraft, the Dutch government said on Friday. The country currently lacks its own aircraft capable of performing such tasks and has relied on NATO's aging AWACS fleet. The GlobalEye can simultaneously monitor air, sea and land over large distances and detect threats including drones and cruise missiles. Delivery of the Dutch aircraft is expected in 2031, but the Netherlands will gain access to Swedish GlobalEye aircraft from 2028 to train crews and begin operations earlier. The Dutch aircraft will join a shared pool with three Swedish GlobalEye aircraft, giving both countries' crews access to the planes. The aircraft can serve as a flying command centre and share real-time intelligence with planes, ships and ground units.

item.title: QatarEnergy seeks US LNG deals through to 2031, sources say
item.description: QatarEnergy is negotiating with several producers to secure multi-year U.S. liquefied natural gas contracts through 2031 to replace capacity knocked out by Iranian attacks that will take years to repair, three trading and industry sources said.
item.dc:creator: Marwa Rashad, Curtis Williams
item.content:encoded: QatarEnergy is negotiating with several producers to secure multi-year U.S. liquefied natural gas contracts through 2031 to replace capacity knocked out by Iranian attacks that will take years to repair, three trading and industry sources said. Discussions include with Venture Global (VG.N) , Cheniere (LNG.N) and Woodside (WDS.AX) , two of the sources said. The contract talks are part of the company's efforts to replace lost volumes from its Ras Laffan facility after two of its 14 LNG trains and a gas-to-liquids (GTL) facility were damaged by Iranian strikes in March, the sources said. The discussions also mark a shift from QatarEnergy's purchases of dozens of U.S. [USN:L8N43I294 TEXT:"spot LNG"] cargoes to help meet commitments to some of its Asian clients, suggesting it is now seeking longer-term solutions to cover the shortfall. QatarEnergy CEO Saad al-Kaabi said in March that the [USN:L6N407161 TEXT:"repairs"] would sideline 12.8 million tons per year of LNG capacity for three to five years. Having halted production in March, QatarEnergy has renewed force majeure notices monthly, most recently extending them to November, with further extensions possible as the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, the sources said. QatarEnergy Trading, the trading arm of QatarEnergy that managed 10 million tons of the company's LNG portfolio, is seeking 2-3 million metric tons per annum through to 2031, one of the sources said. "They will have to buy whatever they can get their hands on," a fourth source said. QatarEnergy did not respond to a Reuters request for immediate comment. Venture Global and Cheniere declined to comment, while Woodside LNG said it does not comment on market speculation. U.S. projects under construction have a total of 25 million metric tons of LNG available for purchase, according to data compiled by research firm Rapidan Energy. Venture Global has the most LNG available with 10 mtpa uncontracted, with both Cheniere and Woodside Energy's having 6 mtpa also available for sale and 3 mtpa available from Sempra's (SRE.N) Port Arthur LNG project, the Rapidan data shows. "Qatar's current pursuit of long-term LNG volumes from other producers to help Qatar deliver into their customer contracts indicates that Qatar now sees risk to their ability to export LNG for several years," said Saul Kavonic, head of energy research and advisory at MST Marquee. "It signals that Qatar considers the disruption of the Strait of Hormuz may prove longer lasting, and the damage to Qatari LNG infrastructure has been more extensive and may take longer to repair than initially hoped," he added. About 80% of Qatar's LNG shipments are typically exported to buyers in Asia. With uncertainty about when flows would resume through the major waterway, many clients in Asia started to seek alternatives to Qatari LNG. Some market participants are stress-testing scenarios in which no Qatari gas is available, according to a fifth source.

item.title: Los legisladores de Reino Unido rechazan la propuesta de legalizar la muerte asistida
item.description: Los legisladores británicos rechazaron el viernes una propuesta para legalizar la muerte asistida de personas con enfermedades terminales, lo que supuso un importante revés para los defensores de esta causa y puso fin al último intento de modificar la ley.
item.dc:creator: Sam Tabahriti, Sarah Young
item.content:encoded: Los legisladores británicos rechazaron el viernes una propuesta para legalizar la muerte asistida de personas con enfermedades terminales, lo que supuso un importante revés para los defensores de esta causa y puso fin al último intento de modificar la ley. El resultado mantiene sin cambios la prohibición británica de la muerte asistida, lo que prolonga un debate que se remonta a décadas sobre si se debería permitir a los enfermos terminales poner fin a sus vidas con asistencia médica y cómo se podría proteger a las personas vulnerables de la coacción si se modificara la ley. La cámara baja del Parlamento, la Cámara de los Comunes, rechazó la ley por 286 votos contra 270. El proyecto de ley habría permitido a los adultos mentalmente competentes y con enfermedades terminales en Inglaterra y Gales, a los que les quedaran seis meses o menos de vida, poner fin a su vida con asistencia médica tras la aprobación de un panel de profesionales. Lauren Edwards, diputada del Partido Laborista del primer ministro Andy Burnham, había vuelto a presentar la legislación mediante un mecanismo conocido como "proyecto de ley de iniciativa parlamentaria", por el que un diputado seleccionado mediante sorteo puede intentar aprobar una ley con independencia del Gobierno. "Es un resultado enormemente decepcionante, no para mí, sino para los muchos miles de personas con enfermedades terminales y sus seres queridos a quienes se les dio esperanza cuando la Cámara de los Comunes votó a favor de este proyecto el año pasado", afirmó en un comunicado, refiriéndose a un respaldo previo a la legislación. El anterior intento de aprobar el proyecto de ley fracasó tras agotarse el plazo en la Cámara de los Lores, la cámara alta no elegida. "Dignidad en la muerte", uno de los grupos que defendía el proyecto de ley, también condenó la decisión como "un revés devastador para las personas moribundas", pero añadió que "esta cuestión no va a desaparecer. El cambio legislativo sobre la muerte asistida sigue siendo una cuestión de cuándo, no de si".

item.title: Braves place OF Lane Thomas (ribs) on injured list
item.description: The Atlanta Braves placed outfielder Lane Thomas on the 10-day injured list Friday with a strained left intercostal muscle.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Atlanta Braves placed outfielder Lane Thomas on the 10-day injured list Friday with a strained left intercostal muscle. Thomas, 31, was a late scratch before Thursday's 3-1 win against the Tampa Bay Rays. His designation is retroactive to Tuesday. Acquired in a trade with the Kansas City Royals on Aug. 2, Thomas is hitting .171 with a homer and three RBIs in 21 games with Atlanta. For the season, he is batting .224 with 11 homers and 40 RBIs in 118 games with the Royals and Braves. Atlanta recalled outfielder DaShawn Keirsey Jr. from Triple-A Gwinnett in a corresponding transaction before Friday's series opener against visiting Philadelphia. The Braves enter the series with a four-game lead over the Phillies in the National League East standings. Keirsey, 29, last played in the majors with the Minnesota Twins in 2025. He is batting .247 with six homers, 36 RBIs and 40 stolen bases in 109 games at Gwinnett this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Monedas suben pese a que aumentan las expectativas de un alza de tasas de la Fed
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban ganancias el viernes, pese a que un esperado dato de la inflación en Estados unidos reforzó aún más las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal (Fed) la próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban ganancias el viernes, pese a que un esperado dato de la inflación en Estados unidos reforzó aún más las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal (Fed) la próxima semana. * El Índice de Precios al Consumo (IPC) de Estados Unidos aumentó un 0,4% el mes pasado, tras un alza del 0,1% en julio, informó el viernes la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales del Departamento de Trabajo. En los doce meses hasta agosto, la inflación al consumo se situó en el 3,4%, tras registrar el mismo incremento en julio. * Los economistas sondeados por Reuters esperaban un alza del 0,4% en términos mensuales y de un 3,4% interanual. Excluyendo los componentes volátiles de alimentos y energía, el IPC subió un 0,3% mensual, tras avanzar un 0,2% en julio. El denominado IPC subyacente fue de un 2,4% interanual en agosto, después de subir un 2,5% en julio. * Los operadores estiman ahora que hay un 85% de probabilidad de que haya una subida de un cuarto de punto en la reunión de la Fed del 15 al 16 de septiembre, frente al 70% aproximadamente que se barajaba antes del reporte. * En el ámbito geopolítico, la atención de los mercados se mantuvo en Oriente Medio, donde el conflicto entre Estados Unidos e Irán recrudeció y volvió a impulsar los precios del petróleo y, con ello, reavivó los temores por la inflación mundial. * El peso mexicano cotizaba en 16,9387 unidades por dólar, con una ganancia de 0,24% frente al precio de referencia de LSEG del jueves. Aun así, en la semana acumulaba una baja del 0,3%. * El principal índice accionario el S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía un 0,44%, a 64.386,28 unidades, pero se encaminaba a anotar su tercera semana consecutiva de pérdidas. * El real brasileño se apreciaba un 0,18%, a 5,0968 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo retrocedía un 0,63%, a 187.088,26 puntos. * [USN:L6N4530TL TEXT:"La inflación anual de Brasil"] se moderó más de lo previsto en agosto, ya que los precios al consumidor registraron su mayor caída mensual en cuatro años, lo que refuerza los argumentos a favor de que el banco central aplique otro recorte de las tasas de interés la próxima semana. * En Argentina, el peso en el mercado mayorista de cambios operaba estable en 1.512,50 unidades por dólar para la venta. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires retrocedía un 0,51% debido a toma de ganancias tras las recientes mejoras. Los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil se pactaban con un alza de apenas un 0,1% promedio. * El peso chileno , caía un 0,18%, a 941,50/941,80 por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , bajaba un 0,22%, a 11.215,35 unidades. * El peso colombiano ganaba un 0,61%, a 3.071 unidades por dólar y en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) caía un 0,80%, a 2.605,80 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreciaba un 0,15%, a 3,3670/3,3690 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) subía un 0,45%, a 1.567,53 puntos. * El Banco Central de Reserva de Perú dejó el jueves estable su tasa de interés de referencia en un 4,25%, lo que extiende su pausa a un décimo tercer mes consecutivo, mientras la inflación se mantiene sobre su rango meta y los indicadores de la economía local muestran un buen desempeño.

item.title: 米ミシガン大消費者信頼感、9月速報値47.8 インフレ懸念で低下
item.description: [ワシントン １１日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が１１日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は４７．８と、８...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感、9月速報値47.8　インフレ懸念で低下 0:03 配信

】2025年11月24日、米国ワシントン州レドモンドのスーパーマーケット　REUTERS/David Ryder

[ワシントン １１日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が１１日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は４７．８と、８月の５１．７から低下した。ガソリン価格の上昇と貿易摩擦を背景に、今後１年間のインフレ加速への懸念が高まったことが重しになった。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は５１．０だった。

信頼感の低下は民主党支持層と共和党支持層でみられた一方、無党派層ではほぼ横ばいだった。

消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は「燃料価格の再上昇と貿易摩擦により、消費者は今後、家計への圧力が一段と強まると見込んでいる」と述べた。

調査の１年後のインフレ期待は４．６％と、前月の４．０％から急上昇した。１年後のインフレ期待は、米国主導のイランとの紛争が始まる前の２月時点では３．４％だった。５年後のインフレ期待は３．４％と、８月の３．３％から小幅に上昇した。２０２４年のレンジ（２．８─３．２％）を上回っている。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：アップル初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ、強気価格が突きつける「誰のためのスマホか」 焦点：米中間選挙に警戒乏しい株式市場、急変動リスク懸念も コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 焦点：5％に迫る米長期金利、借り入れコストや企業価値評価など5つの注目点 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 最終更新: 9/12(土) 0:03 ロイター

item.title: トランプ氏の共和党大会演説、視聴者250万人 「ＮＦＬ超え」と主張も
item.description:
Aditya Soni
[１１日 ロイター] - 米ＦＯＸニュースが放送した、共和党中間選挙大会初日の９日に行われたトランプ米大統領の演説の視聴者数が約２５０万人にとどまったことが分かった。調査会社ニールセンが明らかにした。トランプ氏による「米プロフットボールリーグ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Soni

[１１日 ロイター] - 米ＦＯＸニュースが放送した、共和党中間選挙大会初日の９日に行われたトランプ米大統領の演説の視聴者数が約２５０万人にとどまったことが分かった。調査会社ニールセンが明らかにした。トランプ氏による「米プロフットボールリーグ （ＮＦＬ）の開幕戦を上回った」との主張と食い違う可能性がある。

トランプ氏は９日の演説で、中間選挙を自身の政権運営に対する信任投票と位置付け、「私が投票用紙に載っていると思ってほしい」と呼び掛けた。１０日には、自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、同大会は「誰もが想像した以上に、はるかに大規模で、素晴らしく、重要なものだった」とし、「全体の数字はＮＦＬを上回った」と主張。ただ、具体的な数字や算出方法については明らかにしなかった。

同大会はシアトル・シーホークス対ニューイングランド・ペイトリオッツのＮＦＬシーズン開幕戦と重なった。同試合の視聴率はまだ公表されていないものの、ＮＦＬの昨シーズンの平均視聴者数は１試合当たり約１８００万人で、２０２５年の開幕戦は２８００万人近くに達した。

主要ケーブルテレビ局のうち、約２時間に及ぶトランプ氏の演説を全編放送したのはＦＯＸニュースのみだった。同局の平均視聴者数は２５０万人で、同時間帯の「ＭＳ　ＮＯＷ」（１００万人）やＣＮＮ（４４万１０００人）を上回った。

item.title: Crypto firm Bitcoin Suisse to cut up to half of jobs in Switzerland
item.description: Bitcoin Suisse is cutting up to 60 of its 120 staff in Switzerland as it seeks to reorganise its business, the crypto firm said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bitcoin Suisse is cutting up to 60 of its 120 staff in Switzerland as it seeks to reorganise its business, the crypto firm said on Friday. "Software development and back-office capabilities will increasingly be consolidated in our international hubs, allowing us to scale faster, access broader talent pools and invest more effectively in our future offering," the Zug-based firm said. The staff reductions are due to take effect after a consultation period lasting until September 20, the company said, confirming a report by Swiss outlet Finews. Bitcoin Suisse, which was founded in 2013 and has around 200 employees globally, said it is also closing its IT development site in Copenhagen. Outside Switzerland, the company has an international hub in Bratislava and aims to establish another in Vietnam. It also has offices in Liechtenstein, Abu Dhabi and Bermuda.

item.title: 米ＦＲＢ9月利上げ確率85％に上昇、コアＣＰＩ伸び加速
item.description:
Ann Saphir
[１１日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１１日に発表した８月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）を受け、連邦...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＲＢ9月利上げ確率85％に上昇、コアＣＰＩ伸び加速 9/11 23:35 配信

２０１５年９月撮影　REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque

Ann Saphir

[１１日　ロイター] - 米労働省が１１日に発表した８月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）を受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が来週の会合で利上げに動くとの観測が一段と強まった。

８月のＣＰＩは前月比０．４％上昇し、伸びは７月の０．１％から加速。前年比では３．４％上昇し、７月から横ばいだった。変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除いたコアＣＰＩは前月比０．３％上昇と、７月の０．２％から伸びが加速。前年比では２．４％上昇で、７月の２．５％から鈍化した。

これを受け、１５─１６日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は約８５％と、ＣＰＩ発表前の約７０％から上昇した。

ネイションワイドのチーフエコノミスト、キャシー・ボスティアンシック氏は「原油、ガソリン、ディーゼル価格が再び上昇する中、エネルギー価格の高騰が他の財やサービス、さらにはインフレ期待に波及するとの懸念が強まっている」とし、「ＦＲＢは来週の会合で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定すると予想している」と述べた。

労働省が前日発表した８月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前年比５．４％上昇と、伸びは７月の４．８％から加速。前月比では０．４％上昇と、伸びは７月の０．１％から加速した。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長は８月末に米経済シンポジウム「ジャクソンホール会議」で行った講演で、基調的なインフレ率が目標の２％に向かって鈍化しているとの確信が得られなければ、ＦＲＢには「やるべき仕事がある」と述べ、物価上昇圧力の抑制に利上げが必要になる可能性を示唆した。

エコノミストは、８月のＣＰＩとＰＰＩを受けてもウォーシュ氏が示した基準は満たされていないようにみえるとしながらも、６月と７月のインフレ鈍化を好ましい傾向の始まりとみていたＦＲＢ当局者の間で懸念が強まる可能性は高いとの見方を示している。

インフレーション・インサイツの創業者オマイル・シャリフ氏は「ＦＲＢは今こそ言葉だけでなく行動で示すときだ」と指摘。「ジャクソンホール会議であのような発言をしておきながら、次回会合で利上げを支持しないわけにはいかない。発言を裏付ける行動を取らなければ『オオカミ少年』になってしまう」と述べた。

プリンシパル・アセット・マネジメントのチーフ・グローバル・ストラテジスト、シーマ・シャー氏は「８月のコアＣＰＩが前月比０．３％上昇し、エネルギー価格の急騰とイランを巡る緊張が続いていることを踏まえると、来週の利上げはほぼ確実になった」と指摘。「インフレ率が目標を上回る状態が５年以上続いていることから、政策当局者は物価安定を取り戻すために複数回の利上げが必要になると判断する可能性が高い」と述べた。

ナティクシスのエコノミスト、クリストファー・ホッジ氏は「８月のＣＰＩはコアインフレの再加速を示すものではなく、インフレ鈍化の過程で生じた一時的な振れにすぎない」と指摘。「ＦＲＢは１─２回の利上げが適切と判断する可能性が高く、その第一歩としてまず来週のＦＯＭＣで利上げに踏み切る公算が大きい」との見方を示した。

ＦＲＢは７月２８─２９日に開いた前回のＦＯＭＣでフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．５０─３．７５％に据え置くと決定。据え置きは５会合連続だったが、１２人の委員のうち３人が０．２５％ポイントの利上げを主張し、決定は９対３だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＦＯＭＣと日銀会合、金融政策ウイークの注目点＝植野大作氏 アングル：世界ＭＭＦの資金流入1カ月ぶり高水準、投資家の慎重姿勢強まる アングル：中銀の政策運営、ＡＩ普及で「ディストピア」に直面の恐れ　研究者が警鐘 焦点：ウォーシュ氏の「語らぬ」姿勢に変化、ＦＲＢの対話回帰を市場歓迎 焦点：ジャクソンホール、切望されるウォーシュＦＲＢ議長の明確な政策説明 最終更新: 9/12(土) 0:36 ロイター

LONDON, Sept 11 : Michael Carrick's first Manchester derby as interim manager brought a victory and bought him time. Eight months later, after leading United to a third-placed finish and being appointed on a permanent basis, expectation has soared and Sunday's clash with Manchester City is being viewed as a measure of how far his rebuilding job has progressed. United's former midfield schemer has overseen only one win, against Ipswich Town, in the opening three Premier League matches. A humbling loss at Hull City and a draw at Everton have tempered optimism generated by last season's revival. Thursday's 4-0 victory over Sabah in the Champions League was a welcome boost ahead of the visit of City, but Carrick knows Sunday will provide the acid test.
